item.title: On Ospringe Road by garden wall of 48 Lady Margaret Road, 19th August
item.description:
Hi, On returning from holiday we have found the large hawthorn tree on the pavement outside chopped down, and wide cracking in our garden wall. I cannot find any information about the tree online (there does not appear to have been a s115 Environment Act 2021 consultation, which there ought to have been by size, unless an exception to consultation applied). What has happened please? Also, I see that the Camden website says that if we consider a street tree has damaged our property (I consider it has) we should contact our insurers. Not sure why that should be. Anyway, I am giving Camden notice that I do consider the tree has damaged our property. The wall will need to be looked at for structural integrity etc. All best James
